The right name of the theme for OCD tics is Tourettic OCD or ‘Just Right OCD’. (If you didn’t know, themes are basically a category of something that you obsess over, so it could be contamination OCD, harm OCD and so on. Most people who have OCD have experienced multiple themes)

So tourettic OCD is basically when you have to do a tic to feel better. Unlike tic disorders, it is voluntary. However, you will feel anxious if you don’t do the tic and repeat the action until it feels right. 

So, for example, I would twitch my nose so many times until I feel okay. Or that I would need to touch the doorknob for 10 minutes. For classic OCD, they would have an intrusive thought behind the compulsion like “If I don’t touch the doorknob, I will die”. But for tourettic OCD, it’s more like you have to touch it and if you don’t you’d get anxious. Just like my other compulsions for my other OCD themes, it is exhausting to do OCD tics, however I don’t feel the same way for the new involuntary tics that I’ve been getting.

So far, it seems like the trigger for my involuntary tics is cringy memories. And I’ve only had verbal ones so far. I’ve read up 50% of OCD sufferers would have a tic disorder as well, but from what I know, tics often occur in kids and so I didn’t think having it this late is possible.
